content.title: Module 6
content.subtitle: The climate change - energy nexus
content.body: Thank you for joining us for the third chapter of the Just Energy Transition Module. We invite you to interact with the closing scenario, and to reflect on how you can take action to move these ideas from ambitions into action.

nextBlock.title: Data in Sustainable Energy
nextBlock.cta: Module 7 offers a in-depth introduction to the role of energy data in planning, monitoring, and evaluation for sustainable energy development. It emphasizes the importance of reliable, ethical data for achieving SDG7, explores standardized frameworks, key indicators, and challenges, and introduces innovative tools like AI and energy modeling for informed policymaking.
